extraction_notes: P-channel polarity is preserved: VDS, VGS, ID, breakdown voltage, threshold values, and VSD retain the datasheet's signed values. Resistance and capacitance remain positive quantities.
Fig. 1 output, Fig. 2 transfer, Fig. 3 on-resistance, and Fig. 5 capacitance traces were digitized from direct plotted readings at marked axis positions; no points were interpolated between readings.

RDS(on) table values are 31 mOhm typical and 42 mOhm maximum at VGS = -4.5 V, ID = -5.0 A; 41 mOhm typical and 55 mOhm maximum at VGS = -2.5 V, ID = -4.0 A. Structured resistance values retain the inclusive MAX values.

Additional tabulated DC evidence: IDSS maximum = -1.0 uA at VDS = -20 V, VGS = 0 V; IGSS maximum = +/-15 uA at VGS = +/-10 V, VDS = 0 V; forward transconductance gfs typical = 20 S at VDS = -5.0 V, ID = -4.0 A. Source: p. 2 Static Parameter Characteristics.
Additional body-diode evidence: Qrr typical = 13.8 nC and trr typical = 31 ns at IF = -4.0 A and di/dt = 100 A/us. Source: p. 2 Switching Parameters.
Additional gate-charge evidence: Qg typical = 11 nC, Qgs typical = 2.0 nC, and Qgd typical = 3.0 nC at VGS = -4.5 V, VDS = -10 V, ID = -4.0 A. Source: p. 2 Switching Parameters.
Thermal evidence: RthetaJA maximum = 98 K/W at Ta = 25 degC; no RthetaJC value is published. Source: p. 1 Maximum Ratings.
The supplied datasheet has no explicit manufacturer date or named revision beyond Rev:1.0; all five pages were examined.
